The '''B2-HA super battle droid''', also known as the '''heavy assault super battle droid''',<ref name="CW Toy">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=2009 Basic Figure|pack=#11: Heavy Assault Super Battle Droid|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCW11_SBDheavy.asp}}</ref> was a version of the [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]] equipped with a [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] [[Limb/Legends|arm]] that could launch either a [[Warhead/Legends|warhead]], or [[Homing torpedo/Legends|homing torpedo]].<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref> These [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] were used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and were sometimes assigned as field [[Officer/Legends|officers]].<ref name="CW Toy" /> One of these super battle droids led B1 battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|on]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].<ref name="Ambush" /><ref name="BJ" />

==Characteristics==
The [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2]]-HA series super [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model was equipped with a [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] [[Limb/Legends|arm]] or [[Homing torpedo/Legends|homing torpedo]]. It could be recognized due to a [[Color/Legends|yellow]] symbol on its left shoulder.<ref name="CW Toy" /> It served as a much greater threat during direct combat than its counterpart, capable of creating a large explosion with its cannon attachment.<ref name="COD">{{TCW|Cloak of Darkness}}</ref> Due to their limited abilities as competent [[Commander/Legends|commanders]], they often only led small groups of droids or guarded essential locations on the battlefield.<ref name="BJ" /><ref name="AOI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> The B2-HA series featured heat exchangers on their back.<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:Malevolence_SBD_commander.png|thumb|left|A B2-HA series super battle droid charging its cannon arm]]
During the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Time">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> a B2-HA saw action. It swatted aside its own [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to fire at a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]]. [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone trooper]] [[CT-1226]] targeted its heat exchangers, and the missile it fired hit a [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|Hailfire Droid]]. CT-1226 disabled the B2 with an [[Electromagnetic pulse grenade/Legends|Electromagnetic pulse grenade]] and [[Death/Legends|destroyed]] the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="EGW" />

Heavy super battle droids were used throughout the [[Hunt for the Decimator]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

Early in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], one B2-HA series super battle droid served as part of the [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of [[T81 Division|forces]] under one of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] and [[assassin]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. She was the [[Supreme Leader/Legends|Supreme Leader]] of the forces, and the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist droid forces]] were deployed on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]]. This droid was destroyed by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] during the battle.<ref name="Ambush" />

Shortly after, another of this [[B2-series super battle droid|super battle droid]] was used onboard the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]. An [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]] ordered the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] to destroy a [[Rail jet/Legends|rail jet]] using its cannon arm, almost killing [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="DM">{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}}</ref>

On [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], another super battle droid led droid troops in the [[Senatorial Palace/Legends|Senatorial Palace]]. This droid used a homing torpedo in an attempt to destroy [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], mistaking him for a Jedi. This droid was destroyed, alongside his troops, by the [[Kwazel Maw/Legends|Kwazel Maw]], "[[Bogey (Kwazel Maw)/Legends|Bogey]]."<ref name="BJ" /> When [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] was being transported onboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']], another B2-HA series super battle droid was part of a Separatist boarding party. This droid exited a [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ship]] alongside B2 super battle droids troops and cleared through a Republic defensive in the ''Tranquility''{{'s}} [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] with its cannon arm.<ref name="COD" />

[[Unidentified B2-HA super battle droid (Devaron)|A B2-HA series super battle droid]] served as a commander within [[Nashtah Team]] during [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|attack]] on the Republic outpost on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. The droid acted under [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] during the battle as they prepared to ambush the outpost. Republic forces, however, managed to burst a nearby [[Dam/Legends|dam]] and flood the invasion force.<ref name="AOI" />

An enhanced model known as the [[B2 Assault]] were used during the [[Third battle of Felucia]].<ref name="CWAF">{{TCWA|loc=Felucia}}</ref>

At least three B2-HA series super battle droids were present during the CIS [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|occupation]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. One was present during a small skirmish between the CIS droids and the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]] outside the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] while the other two were present fighting the same group of rebels when they infiltrated Iziz in an attempt to liberate it. However, all three droids were destroyed by the rebels. Onderon would ultimately be liberated from the Separatists, and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Kalani/Legends|Kalani]], who had led CIS forces on the planet, was ordered by [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] Dooku to salvage the remaining arms and withdraw the [[Army/Legends|army]] and bring them to the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]].

==Behind the scenes==
The video game ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]'', which featured the CIS forces through the lense of a real-time strategy game, features a B2 variant called the "heavy super battle droid" with pink markings that features a heavy cannon on its right arm instead of the left.
